revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Readings found in BL 5.42-43 related to lines 3, 4, and 7 have been recorded. Although members of the Heidelberg Seminar arrived at their proposal for line 7 independently of BL 5, the emendation was attributed only to BL.

Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Reading of Ἀπολλ- in line 1 is new. Sarri's emendations in lines 3 and 4 were recorded already in BL 5.42, as was the emendation in line 7 (<:ἀσπάζ〚ον〛\ε/ταί=BL 5.42|ed|ἀσπάζ〚η〛\ε/ταί:>). BL should be cited for this. Sarri's proposal in line 8 can stand as is.

Submit - The papyrus was studied by members of the Heidelberg Papyrology Seminar in the Winter Semester 2016/17. Corrections proposed by A. Sarri to lines 3, 4, and 8 have been added. In addition, Seminar members have read a second lambda (Apoll-) in the first name of line 1 and ον instead of η in the deleted text in line 7. (In preview of line 7, ἀσπάζ〚ον〛\ε/ταί and ἀσπάζ〚η〛\ε/ταί, in the app., do not appear correctly.)
changed schema; added xml:space=preserve; indented; moved title/@n to idno
